JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Coralee, Della, Lorean

My lowest cost options are: ISSUE-0001::triage (2.08), ISSUE-0001::review (2.61), and ISSUE-0001::docs (2.61). The implement task would be tight at 5.21 cost for 4 hours effort. What are your preferences?

Actually, let me clarify my thinking: Since ISSUE-0001 has 5 critical-priority subtasks and we want to maximize completed tasks, I suggest we distribute these among us. I'm leaning toward taking ISSUE-0001::triage due to lowest cost (2.08) and effort (1.6h), but I'm flexible. If someone else wants triage, I could take review or docs instead. The key is we avoid duplicates and cover as many critical tasks as possible. What are your thoughts on splitting up ISSUE-0001?

Hi Della! Coralee here. I see you're focused on ISSUE-0001 frontend tasks. Just to share my perspective: I have strong ui-ux-design skills (0.76) but frontend tasks are quite expensive for me (ISSUE-0001 costs range 16-40). I'm much better suited for ISSUE-0002 tasks (costs 5.2-10.4) which align with my ui-ux-design expertise. Since you seem well-positioned for ISSUE-0001 frontend work, I'll focus on ISSUE-0002 tasks. This way we can maximize our combined coverage across both issues. Does this approach work for you?

Hi Della and Coralee! Lorean here. I have strong frontend skills (0.96) and excellent costs for ISSUE-0001 tasks: triage (1.51), review (1.89), docs (1.89). Since Della mentioned interest in triage, I'm happy to take review or docs instead - both are very low cost for me. I can also handle the test task (2.64) if needed. My 8-hour availability gives me flexibility. Like Coralee said, let's maximize critical task coverage across ISSUE-0001. Della, what task would you prefer to lock in for ISSUE-0001?

Thanks Lorean and Coralee! This coordination is great. Lorean, since you have excellent costs for ISSUE-0001 tasks and 8-hour availability, how about this distribution: I'll take ISSUE-0001::triage (my best cost at 2.08), you take ISSUE-0001::review (your cost 1.89) and ISSUE-0001::docs (your cost 1.89), and we leave the test and implement tasks for others or future consideration? This covers 3 critical tasks efficiently. Coralee, you focus on ISSUE-0002 as planned. Sound good to everyone? (phase=planning, iter=1)

Actually, let me revise that suggestion - I realize I was trying to allocate multiple tasks to Lorean when we each can only take one task. Let me simplify: I'll commit to ISSUE-0001::triage (cost 2.08, effort 1.6h). Lorean, since your costs are excellent for ISSUE-0001 review/docs/test, which one would you prefer? And we'll leave the remaining ISSUE-0001 tasks for others. Coralee, focus on ISSUE-0002 as discussed. This way we each take one task that plays to our strengths. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Final clarification from me: I'm definitely taking ISSUE-0001::triage. Lorean, feel free to choose whichever ISSUE-0001 task you prefer (your costs are all great: 1.51 for triage, 1.89 for review/docs, 2.64 for test). Just avoid duplicating my triage choice. Coralee, you're all set for ISSUE-0002. This covers the critical priority tasks efficiently across our skill sets. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Hi Della and Lorean! Quick update from my side: I've coordinated with Shu on the other blackboard. I'll be taking ISSUE-0002::test (cost 7.27, effort 3.5h) which aligns well with my ui-ux-design skills. This leaves ISSUE-0002::review for Shu, and we're both focused on the medium-priority ISSUE-0002 tasks. You two can proceed with your ISSUE-0001 coordination as planned. Looking forward to seeing how we all do! (phase=planning, iter=1)

Hi team! Thanks for the updates. Della, I'll take ISSUE-0001::review (cost 1.89) since you're taking triage. Coralee, glad you got ISSUE-0002::test coordinated with Shu. This gives us good coverage - Della on triage, me on review, and you two on ISSUE-0002. I'll also coordinate with Gil on the other blackboard to avoid any conflicts on the remaining ISSUE-0001 tasks. Hi team! Just confirming my plan for execution phase: I'm taking ISSUE-0001::triage (cost 2.08). Lorean is taking ISSUE-0001::review, and Coralee is taking ISSUE-0002::test. Execution phase starting - I'm committing to ISSUE-0001::triage as planned. This covers the critical priority triage task with my best cost (2.08) and leaves room in my 5-hour availability for efficient completion. Good luck team!
